content:
maria: heads up — planning a schema change to console_events to add quota_dimension (account_id, org_id, product_tier). want to discuss migration strategy and dashboard impacts
kevin: do we need downtime for this?
maria: ideally no. plan is dual-write new column (NULL default) + background backfill, then flip reads. low-risk but need to coordinate retention and cost for backfill
ajay: dual-write + feature flag sounds right. also we should keep read-fallback to old path if new field missing to avoid UI errors
elaine: dashboard owners: will event shape change for the telemetry pipeline? alerts and aggregated metrics depend on event.labels today
data-eng: short answer: yes shape changes. quota_dimension will be an object flattened into three columns. that means rework of our parquet schema and partitioning. cost will spike during backfill. recommend new partition key on (date, product_tier)
maria: proposed phased rollout: 1) deploy schema migration that adds columns (no NOT NULL), 2) enable dual-write in API (flagged), 3) run backfill job to populate historical rows for last 90 days, 4) once backfill verified, switch reads to prefer new columns, 5) after 30d, drop old aggregation hack columns
kevin: SQL snippet for the add-table step i used locally — mirrors what we'll run in prod (admin-only):
```sql
ALTER TABLE console_events ADD COLUMN quota_product_tier varchar(64);
ALTER TABLE console_events ADD COLUMN quota_org_id bigint;
ALTER TABLE console_events ADD COLUMN quota_account_id bigint;
-- then create indexes used by queries
CREATE INDEX ON console_events (quota_product_tier, created_at DESC);
```
ajay: backfill plan: do chunked COPY from WAL-export or run streaming mapreduce over parquet. careful with KV-cache saturating the DB. rate-limit and schedule off-peak jobs. also split backfill per region to avoid cross-region egress spikes
infra-bot: scheduled migration window: 2024-12-12 02:00-06:00 UTC — infra team will throttle background jobs in that window :calendar: 
deploy-bot: canary job created: https://deploys.internal/redwood/canary/console-events-schema — monitors ingestion error rate, p50/p99 write latency
elaine: UI mapping note — console needs to surface product_tier in quota usage breakdown. sample frontend mapping config:
```yaml
quota_mapping:
  productTierField: "quota_product_tier"
  orgField: "quota_org_id"
  accountField: "quota_account_id"
```
console-eng: remember to update the telemetry transformation (beam job) to accept both old and new fields during the dual-write window so dashboards don't break
maria: action items: (1) data-eng to produce cost estimate for backfill by EOD Wednesday, (2) infra to confirm migration window and throttles, (3) console-eng + elaIne to update dashboards and UI mapping, (4) ajay to own dual-write feature flag rollout. tagging @kevin to schedule a short sync tomorrow. thanks :thumbsup:
kevin: ack
